notes.title: Motion blur issue: Choice between DirectX 12 or DirectX 11
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Some of you have reported motion blur issues since the last update. This seems to stem from the switch to DirectX 12 that we made on some PCs.

So that you can continue to play without any worries, we have left the option to launch the game either in DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 directly from the Steam launcher. Here is the procedure:

[list]
[*] Launch the game from Steam.
[*] In the window that appears, choose the desired option.
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and happy gaming!

Teddy

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 available
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone,

Update 0.2.1 is now available on the main branch!
As mentioned in the last two news posts, here’s a reminder of the new features and bug fixes ⬇[/h3]

[b][h3]Nightclub & Bar [/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001136/c3812b32b26feccbd2aaf37e0178c325987e1ec5.gif[/img]

Nighttime now offers a new gameplay phase for clients with more specific desires: having a drink and dancing for several hours!

At level 3, an additional objective appears to guide you.

The nightclub lights up at night — all you have to do is prepare your best cocktails to serve at the bar. Clients will sit down and tell you what they want; serve their orders just like a real bartender.

💡 [b]You can add your own music to the game![/b] To do so, stand in front of the jukebox, hi-fi, or nightclub, and press "G". This automatically opens the folder where you can drop your music files.

[b][h3]Ferry Management[/h3][/b]
From now on, you decide how many ferries land on your island. In the new "ferries" tab on the computer, check or uncheck the schedules you want, and organize your day as you wish.
[b]On older saves, during the first two days you may see some empty ferries, but this should fix itself by day 3. If the problem persists, don’t hesitate to contact us![/b]

[b][h3]Decoration[/h3][/b]

[b]Trees and clusters of tropical rocks[/b] to embellish your island with a natural, tropical style. These decorations unlock between level 4 and 10!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001136/8ece1ad9a42a5d0bf0382bb2986dfdd916dd9919.gif[/img]

(From now on, when you start a new game, we’ve added a few of these decorations to the island for free. They do not give hype points. To add more, you’ll need to unlock levels and purchase them in the shop.)

[b]Little by little, new styles and colors:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001136/1736e9c476603f468522b824f7a0fea931744cce.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001136/d62cc698ce1580752ec8b7e8940d9fb94cad46be.jpg[/img]

+ 1 color for the square restaurant table (beige wood)
+ 1 restaurant table (round) with two color variations (white wood, orange wood)
+ 8 colors for floors, fences, pergolas
+ 3 beach towel patterns

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001136/0b86cc919665905b6700c4758efc103bb5dcea5f.jpg[/img]

💡 [b]To change style, stand in front of the object and press "F"[/b]

[b][h3]Improvements & Bug Fixes[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*] For better profitability, jetskis now consume 2x less fuel,
[*] Clients sleeping in yellow and blue bungalows were misplaced,
[*] After saving, sleeping clients could still have their request bubble visible,
[*] Bungalows could be reserved far in advance even if clients weren’t on the island,
[*] Jetski fuel count could go negative, causing incorrect refills,
[*] Employees couldn’t reach all areas compared to clients,
[*] In some saves, ferries didn’t appear,
[*] In some saves, clients requested a bungalow even if it was free,
[*] In some saves, a phantom ferry prevented sleeping,
[*] In some saves, clients got stuck while eating,
[*] Trampoline animation didn’t trigger for female models,
[*] DirectX 12 build: fixed performance issues with Intel GPUs,
[*] "Mango seeds" were mistakenly translated as "Coconut seeds",
[*] The bar no longer appears in the tablet,
[*] Chocolate ice cream recipe now requires a coconut shell,
[*] Jacuzzi was listed twice in the level screen,
[*] Grilled crab with lemon recipe no longer displays "x5" in the interface,
[*] Treasures remain hidden until the associated map is found or purchased,
[*] Client summary now also shows the number of souvenirs requested,
[*] Balloons no longer get stuck in tropical rock clusters,
[*] Added nighttime cricket SFX,
[*] Added daytime seagull SFX,
[*] Added "ding" timer SFX for the sorbet machine, oven, and blender,
[*] Male employee models were misaligned with their positions,
[*] Employees (especially cleaners) no longer get stuck in bungalows due to trash cans too close to walls,
[*] Fixed a bug where saves could reset after reloading (loss of level, money, quests, and buildings),
[*] The nightclub can no longer be placed on a wooden floor (overlapping textures),
[*] Fixed an issue where only level 1 clients could arrive, even on night ferries,
[*] Clients leaving the bar without being served are no longer stuck to it ("drink requested" no longer stays blocked),
[*] Removed an old useless message that appeared on tables,
[*] Fixed a bug related to ferry generation at level 10,
[*] Fixed fertilizer-related errors (save, wheat, pointer),
[*] Clients leaving a table without finishing their meal no longer block it.
[/list]

[b][h3]🌴 Roadmap Update 🌴[/h3][/b]

💪June
✅Employees (cleaner + cashier)
✅Night ferries
✅Steam achievements
✅More save slots

🫰July
🔜 Employees (cook + collector)
✅New decorations added
✅New sound effects added

✨August
🔜Themed Days (challenges):
- Shrimp Day
- Corsair’s Fire
🔜New decorations

💡September
Scenario: Act 3 (Old Joe’s Revelations)
A new event system (Wedding organization, …)
Clients & Resorts from level 10 to 15
New activities (Fireworks… and more)
New decorations!
New recipes (Wedding cake and more!)
Craftable items!
Treasures and places to explore!

🔥Q1 2026
Scenario: Act 4 (Fateful Reunions)
Clients & Resorts from level 16 to 20
New activities, items, and treasures
AND MUCH MORE!

See you soon for more!

Teddy & Marine

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.1 [BETA BRANCH]
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are releasing a patch that fixes several issues reported by the community:

[list]
[*] ✅ The models of male employees are no longer offset from their position.
[*] ✅ Employees (especially cleaners) no longer get stuck in bungalows due to trash cans being too close to the walls.
[*] ✅ Fixed a bug where the save could reset after a reload (loss of level, money, quests, and buildings).
[*] ✅ The nightclub can no longer be placed on a wooden floor (overlapping textures).
[*] ✅ Resolved an issue where only level 1 customers could arrive, even on a night ferry.
[*] ✅ Customers leaving the bar without being served no longer remain linked to it (the "drink requested" no longer gets stuck).
[*] ✅ Removed an old unnecessary message that appeared on tables.
[*] ✅ Fixed a bug related to the generation of ferries at level 10.
[*] ✅ Fixed errors related to fertilizers (save, wheat, pointer).
[*] ✅ Customers leaving a table without finishing their meal no longer block the table.
[/list]

Thank you again for your feedback and reports! 🙏
Continue to help us improve the game ❤️

notes.title: Teaser: Night ferries and nightclub
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[h3]Here’s a teaser for our next update (early August), with the addition of night ferries [/h3]!

It was supposed to arrive this weekend, but there is still about 10% of work left to do, and we didn’t want to push it to the beta branch in its current state. We still need to refine the ambiance (lighting, game interface), and test that all mechanics work well (edge cases, etc).

📣 Here’s what will be new:

-Night ferries, with a different clientele, and the addition of two activities: bar and nightclub. Serve drinks on demand, and crank up the sound system so your guests dance until dawn!

-You’ll be able to add your own music to the game! Demonstration below [u](music not included in the update)[/u]
[previewyoutube=ZWGD7lMCbW8;full][/previewyoutube]

-More precise ferry management throughout the day: manage the flow of ferries you want to host on your island, day and night, from your computer.

-Addition of decoration with 7 new palm trees and rock formations. We started from the observation that the island feels too empty when you arrive in the game for the first time. We decided to improve the environment by adding these palm trees and natural decorations. They can be reused by the player to embellish their island. Since they’re present on the island from the start, they do not bring any hype points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001136/a6b3445f40ed493176b32aecefe18dbf2d9a511a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001136/ed050831ae36faa1cbedf42618735c4a968d6ebb.jpg[/img]

-For players who are already well advanced in the game and do not wish to start over, you can also find these 7 natural decoration items in the shop as you level up!

-Addition of some SFX

[i]Quick note about employees
The cook and the Harvester will arrive in a future update because we didn’t have time to develop them yet. Indeed, our dilemma as gamedevs is choosing between fixing bugs or pushing ahead with content. Naturally, we are running a bit behind, but this doesn’t change our roadmap plan—just its timing 🙂[/i]

☀ Finally, we’re taking a few days off starting tonight, after months of a relentless work pace. We’ll remain connected (from afar) on Discord, but we’re reading you (always)!

Back in the first week of August for the update

See you soon!

Teddy & Marine

notes.title: Update 0.1: First Two Employees, Steam Achievements, Sound Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️ New Update![/h1]

[h3]🧑‍🍳 The waiter and janitor are here![/h3]

Using them is very simple:
[list]
[*] Reach level 3, then head to the in-game PC.
[*] In the "Employees" tab, you’ll be able to choose who to hire.
[/list]
🧹 The janitor takes care of:
[list]
[*] Picking up trash bags and loading them onto the boat.
[*] Emptying beach trash bins.
[*] Cleaning towels, sunbeds, bungalows, and tents.
[/list]
🍽️ The waiter collects payments from guests for:
[olist]
[*] Activities.
[*] The restaurant.
[*] The souvenir shop.
[/olist]
➕ Useful info:
[list]
[*] Each employee has a hiring cost and a daily salary. Make sure to manage your budget!
[*] As your resort gains notoriety, you'll be able to hire more staff.
[*] To dismiss an employee: walk up to them and press F.
[*] If you forget to pay them, they won’t work!
[/list]

[b]We hope these new employees will make your life easier.[/b]  
The next two are already in the works: [b]the cook and the forager.[/b]

[h2]Also in this update:[/h2]

[h3]🏆 50+ Steam Achievements![/h3]
We know many of you were waiting for them!  
Some achievements are simple, others a bit longer, but none of them require grinding.  
We wanted achievements that you could unlock naturally as you play.

[h3]🔊 Complete Sound Overhaul[/h3]
Some of you playing on speakers reported the volume was too low.  
We’ve remastered all the audio for a better result.  
👉 Let us know your thoughts after this update!

[h3]🍽️ New Eating Animation[/h3]
Guests seemed a bit bored while eating...  
We added an extra animation to make the moment feel more lively!

[h3]🧍‍♂️ New Button to Remove Stuck Guests[/h3]
It shouldn't happen, but sometimes… a guest gets stuck.  
You’ll now find a button in the menu to remove them if needed.  
Of course, we’re actively working so you never have to use it.

[h3]🎮 Option: Invert Y-Axis for the Camera[/h3]
Some players with motion sickness requested it:  
The option is now available in the settings.  
Feel free to suggest other accessibility options!

[h3]📚 New Help Section[/h3]
A new help section on farming has been added:  
How to plant trees 🌳

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]

Here are the bugs fixed in this version:

[list]
[*] Guests could get stuck chasing a beach ball — they now give up after 20 seconds.
[*] Beach balls now bounce properly on trampolines without getting stuck.
[*] Mango tree positions were not saved correctly.
[*] Reversed trash bins could block guests leaving tables — now fixed.
[*] Check their orientation if you're unsure.
[*] It was possible to overwrite an existing save with the same name.
[*] Flower seeds didn’t work — now fixed.
[*] An "invisible wall" bug when using the mixer for cocoa paste has been fixed.
[*] The yellow tutorial window translated “Hide to show” instead of “H to show”.
[*] Clearer indication of the end of Act 2.
[*] The text for exiting the jetski was cut off.
[*] Visual overhaul of the bottom-right UI (held item description).
[*] Workshop UI: ingredients no longer overlap with recipes.
[*] Shell powder, chocolate, and cocoa paste can no longer get stuck on food counters.
[*] In some cases, dishes could float above the stove.
[*] Multiplayer: in some cases, boxes weren’t synced with the guest player.
[*] Portuguese translation: replaced the word "robalo" with "pargo".
[*] Corrected translation for the “Floor” 2x2 and 4x4 objects.
[/list]

Thanks to all of you for your feedback, messages, and shared save files!  
Keep reporting bugs — we read everything.

And most of all: have fun on your island 🏝️

— The Paradise Beach Simulator Team

notes.title: 🛠 Patch 0.0.4 – Notes de mise à jour
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback! Here are the fixes made in this version:

🏖️ The umbrellas were no longer displaying correctly — they are back on the beach!

🛳️ On day 30, after a save, the generation of a ferry could make the game unstable — this bug is now fixed.

😴 Customers were not waking up after a night's sleep — they will now come out of their tent as expected.

⚠️ A warning message now appears when clicking on "New Game" to avoid accidentally overwriting your save.

⏰ Customers who were waiting for an activity after midnight no longer left — for old saves, they will leave the island at 5:30; for new ones, they will leave just after the activity.

🧭 Objects now show their direction of use, to facilitate their placement.

💡The ice cream maker was too bright.

Teddy and Marine

notes.title: Patch day 2 V 0.0.3 !
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Here is our second update since the release. We are carefully reading all your feedback, and we continue to improve the game day by day — thank you for your support ❤️

[h2]✨ Improvements
[/h2][list]
[*] Stereos now break down even less frequently. If this is still not enough, we will further reduce their breakdown rate.
[*] The time system now correctly manages days after June 30 — welcome to an infinite June without crashes!
[*] Small torches are now properly unlocked at level 2.
[/list]


[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes
[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some customers did not reappear correctly after loading a save.
[*] Fixed a critical bug that prevented the game from functioning properly after reaching day 31.
[*] Recipes for rum and arranged rum are now available.
[*] The treasure map of the "sacred" fruit revealed... nothing at all. This is now fixed!
[*] The objective "Make rum for Silvia" could disappear if the boat was unloaded — this is resolved.
[*] Fixed a bug where some customers could get stuck in the rock.
[*] The text "Go to sleep" no longer overlaps with Old Joe's dialogue.
[/list]

[h2]🔜 Coming Up
[/h2][list]
[*] The employee system is almost ready: soon, you will not be alone in managing the resort!
[*] A system for multiple save locations is under development.
[/list]

🧉 We continue to work hard to make each day spent on the island even more enjoyable. Thank you for being there 🙏

[h3]Thank you for this first day full of emotions <3

Teddy and Marine

notes.title: Demo Update 2 !
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's update time!

First of all, we wanted to let you know that this version is not compatible with previous save files. [u]We sincerely apologize for this [/u]🙏. We are now using a much more reliable system, so this shouldn't happen again.

To make it up to you, we've added some exciting new content that makes starting a fresh game totally worth it!

[h2]New Content :[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001136/651aa21db3b3fb41a573180b1732f42af9e88762.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] 🛌 Guests can sleep on the island: Buy rustic tents or cozy bungalows so your guests can stay overnight!
[*] 🥭 Sell island products at a market stall: Fruits, fish, and seashells can now be put up for sale!
[*] 🚪 Open and close the beach: You now have full control over your days! Decide when the beach is open to guests and take breaks to prepare your island.
[*] 🚮 A beach trash bin is now available so your guests can dispose of their garbage properly.

[h2]Bugs & Balancing[/h2]

Many of you have sent feedback through the in-game report system (F3). [u]Know that we read and log everything.[/u] Thank you once again! Here are the main fixes:

[list]
[*] The garbage boat is now cheaper
[*] Mangoes are easier to spot in mango trees
[*] Snorkeling mask bug fixed
[*] Optimizations and LOD improvements for fruit and fish models
[*] Descriptions and product images added to the shop
[*] Mangoes and lemons now respawn faster in their respective trees
[*] Fewer collision issues!
[*] We hope you’ll love these changes!
[/list]

This is the last content update before Steam Fest at the end of February.
However, we will continue making minor bug fixes if needed in the coming days.

[h3][b]Feel free to leave us a little review on the demo page to support us 🫰[/b][/h3]

See you soon!

Teddy & Marine

notes.title: Notes de Patch - Jour 1
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h3]🔄 Tutorial Update: [/h3]

Added instructions for placing a dish on the counter to better guide new players.

[h3]👉 Adjustments[/h3]

[list]
[*] Interaction with customers: Removal of the 'E' indicator for customers who are not in front of the cash register.
[*] Old Joe's Instructions: Old Joe now advises players to go to sleep after placing the coconut shrimp on the counter.
[*] Shrimp Detection: Reduction of the shrimp detection area in the tutorial for more precise interaction.
[*] User Interface Improvements: Improved visibility of the loading indicator when long pressing 'E' to help players better understand interaction times.
[/list]

[h3]🐞Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Restaurant Counter: Fixed an issue where removing a food counter disrupted the restaurant's functionality.
[*] Diving Mask Stand: Fixed a bug causing save file corruption related to the diving mask.
[*] Decoration Placement: Corrected the placement height of decorations to avoid unrealistic configurations.
[*] Clipping Issues:
[*] Adjusted palm trees and leaves so they don't protrude from the ground.
[*] Fixed the issue of cardboard pieces overflowing through the shelf.
[*] Inventory Glitches: Resolved an issue where boxes duplicated and fell into the shelf after a save load.
[*] Jetski Position: Ensures the jetski appears in the correct place after loading a save.
[*] Wildlife Appearance: Reduced the spawn area of shrimp.
[*] Menu Corrections:
[*] Some dishes were mis-categorized.
[*] Adjusted the category of sashimi to reflect its status as an appetizer.
[*] Sound Balancing: Lowered the volume of explosion effects to match the general sound levels of the game.
[*] Navigation Aids: Added a red arrow to guide players to salmon locations, improving the user experience without solely relying on map icons.
[*] Camera Mechanics: Modified the cash register camera to prevent it from lowering too much, improving transaction visibility.
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay Improvements:
[/h1]
[h3]🧹 Cleaning Stage[/h3]

Introduction of a new stage in the tutorial to encourage players to clean the towel.

[h3]🌅 Visual and Environmental Adjustments[/h3]

Environmental Ambience: The customers' environmental bubble has been removed as it was too aggressive, to improve players' visual comfort.

[h3]🌴 Thank you for your feedback and support. 🫰
Enjoy your enhanced experience in Paradise Beach Simulator![/h3]

Teddy & Marine
